import asyncio


async def map_with_concurrency[T](items: list[T], width: int, operation) -> None:
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )


async def plain(items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )
